name: Channeler
description:
You feel the anger rising within you and you welcome it. It is a tool. It is your tool. It is the thing you have that other people don’t have. You feel a prickling across your skin as you begin to move your arms in graceful, forceful arcs - the practiced movements you've made innumerable times. The anger blooms into something more: a store of energy that you hold within yourself in anticipation of release. A half step to one side and a leaning twist as you pivot your stance physically and mentally, allowing your deepest insecurities to further fuel your elevated state. Your vision is becoming blurry, you feel yourself at the edge of what you can control. You plant your feet and push your arms forward, releasing all the built-up emotion at once with a cry. A mote of flame leaps forth from your palms, the pain and anguish of your lived experience expressed in a terrible, tangible, satisfying moment of release. Your head is clear now but power remains gathered in your chest - you feel it refreshed after a moment of rest. With a step backward, you begin another sweeping motion, capturing the fear you feel as you see dark forms begin to charge toward you, leaping over the charred bodies of their compatriots...

Channelers funnel their own emotions into elemental spellcasting power. They produce some of the most dramatic, devastating magical effects on the battlefield, but they do so at great risk to themselves and to those around them. Their magic is big, physical, loud, dramatic and conspicuous.

The Channeler mestiere uses Conditions as a resource. You will cast spells that cause you to check Conditions, elevating your emotions, then casting release spells that allow you to uncheck Conditions, amplifying the spell's effects with each Condition you uncheck. This cycle of accumulation and release of Conditions is the core of the Channeler discipline. As a result, the threat of a Bout of Madness is ever-present.

While other mestieri make use of mestiere points, for a Channeler, "MP" stands for mana pool - a reserve of energy that you build up and use to cast spells. Mana is divided into five colors, each of which is associated with an elemental force, is tied to one of the five Conditions, and gathers around a different domain of emotion:

  • White mana controls Air (🜁) and gathers around protection, obligation, and selflessness. It reinforces defenses, prevents harm, and binds people together through proximity and shared responsibility. Channeling white mana causes the Channeler to become Troubled—strained by responsibility and the knowledge that order must be constantly reinforced or crumble in a chaotic world. When that emotion is released, white mana imposes sweeping order: creating boundaries, limiting movement and diffusing chaos.

  • Blue mana controls Water (🜄) and gathers around possibility and intervention. It reacts to the world as it unfolds, subtly redirecting events, revising outcomes, and replacing what is with what could be. Channeling blue mana cause the Channeler to become Insecure, as they feel the tension between intention and outcome, and a growing awareness that not all variables can be controlled. When that emotion is released, blue mana takes control. It restricts choices, reshapes abilities, and dictates the terms under which actions can succeed or fail.

  • Black mana controls Darkness (🝯) and gathers around accumulation and extraction. It draws power inward, undermines opposition, and converts suffering, weakness, or loss into advantage. It values results over cost. Channeling black mana causes the Channeler to become Afraid, as they feel the anxiety of knowing that what you've taken can be taken back. When that emotion is released, black mana consumes what surrounds it and unleashes reckless, shared suffering.

  • Red mana controls Fire (🜂) and gathers around passion and impatience. It accelerates motion, amplifies impact, and favors decisive action over deliberation. Its magic is fast and disruptive. Channeling red mana causes the Channeler to become Angry as they feel the friction caused by resistance, delay, or restraint. When that emotion is released, red mana discharges explosively, destroying obstacles and scattering order.

  • Green mana controls Earth (🜃) and gathers around force applied without refinement. It destabilizes the battlefield, shifts terrain, and creates sudden, overwhelming advantages. Channeling green mana causes the Channeler to become Guilty, as the weight of collateral damage, imbalance, and consequences left unresolved weighs on them. When that emotion is released, green mana hardens into stability: power settles and strengths are reinforced.

Spells of a given mana color may cause you to check or uncheck any of the five Conditions, but their effects are most potent when powered by the Condition tied to that mana color.

Your Channel ability allows you to add specific colors of mana to your mana pool. Each Channeler spell has a mana cost, which requires that you spend varying amounts of mana: mana of specific colors, mana of any color, or a combination of both. Spending mana does not remove it from your mana pool, but rather causes it to become tapped: you cannot use it again until it becomes untapped. All your tapped mana becomes untapped at the beginning of each of your turns.

The Channeler mestiere has more to keep track of than most, and thus it tends to pull your focus inward - toward the state of your character sheet as well as the emotional state of your character - but then it explodes outward, leaving a huge mark on the battlefield.

Play a Channeler if you want to:

  • Do big, loud magic, achieving the most massive magical effects the game has to offer.

  • Build and spend emotional energy, managing a mana pool that you fill yourself and spend on spells across a range of emotional domains.

  • Harness emotional extremes — elevate your emotions in pursuit of greater power, approaching the edge of madness to achieve maximum effect.

Questions to consider when making a Channeler:

  • How did they learn to channel mana? Did they discover it on their own or did they learn from a teacher? Does Channeling run in their family?

  • Which color do they gravitate toward most, and what does that say about who they are — do they sacrifice themselves for others, control from a distance, brood in darkness, burn bright, or cause big disruptions they later regret?

  • What is their relationship to the risk of madness? Do they fear it, accept it as an occasional cost, or charge toward it recklessly?

  • Has their emotional life always been an asset, or did they have to learn to stop running from the feelings they now wield as weapons?

  • How do they deal with the comedown that follows intense cycles of emotional accumulation and release?

novizio.description: You are initiated in the art of channeling mana. You are practiced in accumulating and releasing emotion, and have learned a handful of spells.
novizio.baseMpNotes: For Channelers, "MP" stands for "mana pool." You fill your mana pool through your Channel ability, among others.
novizio.abilities: Channel, Mana From Within, Shape Elements, and one ability of your choice of each mana color, excluding multicolored abilities.
novizio.spellcasting: Your spellcasting is highly physical. To cast spells, you must have all of your limbs free and must be wearing no armor. Each spell you cast requires obvious physical movement and generates light and sound.
novizio.gratuiti: Richly dyed clothes and footwear that are easy to move in, a journal or meditative token.
